name: tr2
notes: The tr2 Turkish OmniVoice LoRA (checkpoint-6000): 14,505 Alania clips, 9,171 YODAS clips, 994 Antalia clips, and the user's own voice doubled (710 + 309 clips x2). Measured rows in tts_lab/data/omni2/train.jsonl. Run settings mirror tts_lab/kaggle/omnivoice-tr2.zip config/train.json. Full configs live in that zip.
